thread.title: GBH Insights: Apple will sell 350M iPhone units in the next year - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: GBH Insights: Apple will sell 350M iPhone units in the next year - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
GBH Insights expects this year’s Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) iPhones to sell up to 350M units in the next 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Daniel Ives says many existing iPhone owners didn’t upgrade last year since the 8 and 8 Plus were similar to earlier models and the X was too expensive for many users.
This year’s iPhone lineup is expected to include an X update with a more modest price in the $700 to $800 range and an X Plus for those wanting a premium model.
Ives says China is a significant opportunity with about 100M iPhone customers with about 60M to 70M due for an upgrade over the next 18 months.
